tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur zhal rdo rje rab brtan ma tshe ring ma bcas kyi gtor bsngo bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ gtor ma zlum gtor lnga'am phye tshugs gang rigs/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod dang bcas pa bshams la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyis mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i dge ba 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūm̐ yig las/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa drwa gur gyi nang / /sna tshogs pad zla 'byung po'i gdan stengs su/ /rang sems rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ /rang nyid 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog nag /zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin/ /rtsa phyag 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyag rgya mdzad/ /mi mgo skam rlon sbrul dang rus rgyan bcas/ /dar sngon stod g.yogs stag lpags sham thabs gsol/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs la yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' byon/ /dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha mdun du byon/ /dbang bskur mi bskyod pa yi rgyas btab gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags kyis bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod dang sems can don/ /rnam gnyis mthar phyin rang la thim par gyur/ /hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ mdun gyi gtor ma rnams/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shū d+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shū dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me mi mgo'i steng / /thod pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yis gang / /ye shes lnga ldan yig 'bru'i 'od zer las/ /'khor 'das bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus dbyer med gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus/ /pad nyi ro gdan nag po chen po'i sku/ /gri gug thod khrag gaṇ+ḍe'i phyag mtshan can/ /khro bo'i chas rdzogs pho nya lnga yis bskor/ /g.yon du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng / /yum chen ral gcig sngon mo g.yu bum 'dzin/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs stag lpags sham thabs can/ /rin chen rus rgyan ral pa g.yon du 'phyang / /de yi lte bar 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas pa gnyis/ /ral gri thod 'dzin g.yon gnyis mdung thung dang / /rtse gsum dar nag cod paṇa phur ba bsnams/ /khro mo'i chas rdzogs mi ro zhal du gsol/ /btsan skyel bong bu gwa dmar steng du bzhugs/ /mgon po'i g.yas su pad nyi ro gdan la/ /tsa turmu kha phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing steng zhal dud/ /phyag bzhi'i dang po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /'og ma ral gri thod skam phreng ba 'phyar/ /gser bum bdud rtsis gang ba mtshan du thogs/ /khro bo'i cha lugs dor stabs tshul du bzhugs/ /g.yung mo gtum go sring mo seng ga lī/ /nag ljang dmar ser gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su bzhugs/ /lcam dral mdun du pad nyi ro gdan lngar/ /nag po gnod sbyin gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /nag mo gnod sbyin spu gri thod khrag 'dzin/ /gshin rje pu tra shang lang thod khrag 'dzin/ /bdud chen bha ṭa dam shing mi snying 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin sring mo spu gri rgyu zhags 'dzin/ /thams cad drag po'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs/

/khrag mtsho bong bu gwa dmar gdan stengs su/ /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /smug nag gri thod ne'u le'i rkyal ba 'dzin/ /khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ /sna tshogs pad nyi dkyil 'khor lnga yi steng / /dbus su bkra shis tshe ring sku mdog dkar/ /g.yas pa gser rdor g.yon pa bum pa 'dzin/ /dung gi thor tshugs seng ge dkar mo chibs/ /shar du mthing gi zhal bzang sku mdog sngo/ /g.yas pa me long g.yon pa ba dan 'dzin/ /dbang sngon thor tshugs rkyang bu kha dkar chibs/ /lho phyogs mi g.yo blo bzang sku mdog ser/ /g.yas pa zas gzhong g.yon pa ster ba'i tshul/ /gser gyi thor tshugs stag mo grus ma chibs/ /nub tu cod paṇa mgrin bzang sku mdog dmar/ /g.yas pa nor bu g.yon pa mdzod sgrom 'dzin/ /byu ru'i thor tshugs shwa ba yu mo chibs/ /byang du gtad dkar 'gro bzang sku mdog ljang / /g.yas pa dur chun g.yon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /g.yu yi thor tshugs g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs/ /lnga ka'ang mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa'i sku/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /bstan srung gtso 'khor rnams kyi mtha' skor du/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ /kun gyi sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ so so'i dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī e ka dza ṭī tsa turmu kha karma nā tha badz+ra pra sbi ra pañtsa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+na daṃ ba liṃ ta ya swāhā/ lan ji ltar rigs pa/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/

/bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/ /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med 'grub pa dang / /byang chub bar du bsrung skyob sdong grogs mdzod/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de kun mgon po'i bzod par gsol/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ rang nyid 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sku gsung thugs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun/ /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur cig /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog /lha brgyad dang zhal gyi bris 'bur gyi sku med na/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi rjes su/ mgon po lha brgyad dang zhal gtso 'khor rnams rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ gtor ma dang mchod 'bul sogs kyi phyag rgya bca' ba'am/ ma byung yang dmigs pa gsal zhing cho ga la lhag chad med na phyag rgya med kyang de tsam gyi 'gal ba med par sems so/ /zhes pa 'di yang mda' dpon 'bum thang pa dngos grub rnam rgyal gyi dngos su gsung gis bskul ba dang / phyag bris kyi don 'bras la'ang de bzhin gsungs pa bzhin/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mngon rtogs rnams shin tu bsdus shing sngags kyang mtshan sngags su bsdus pa'i khyer bde 'di bzhin brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
